questions.q: Which medium's audience chooses where to look?
questions.explain: On stage everything happens in one shared space; on screen the camera chooses for you.

questions.q: What is the biggest structural difference in journalism?
choices: You must find the structure in real events rather than invent it
There's no need for a question to hold the reader
questions.explain: You can't invent a better ending; your art is finding and ordering.

questions.q: Why can screenwriting guides put beats on specific page numbers?
choices: Because of the convention that one page is about one minute
Because plays use the same page counts
Because editors cut from the bottom
questions.explain: The page-a-minute convention and the industry's standardized reading make the form measurable.

questions.q: In hard news, why are facts ordered from most to least important?
choices: So readers can stop anywhere and editors can cut from the bottom
Because the nut graf comes last
questions.explain: The inverted pyramid serves a reader who might leave at any moment.

questions.q: Why does so much theater take place in one room over a short time?
choices: Location and time changes are costly, and confinement builds pressure
questions.explain: Scarcity of time and place is a constraint that playwrights turn into pressure.

questions.q: On screen, a character's inner change mainly has to be…
questions.explain: Film is a medium of pictures. Inner life has to become visible behavior.
